Overview

Parma is a city in Emilia-Romagna with a population of 198,000. A food lover’s paradise, famous for Parmigiano-Reggiano, Prosciutto di Parma, and a rich musical and artistic heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 47.0.
